blocks.en: At noon the next day, the trumpet sounded from the top of the Tower of Voices. “Attention, please!” cried [[Announce|announce]]. “At the bell, in five minutes, the truth will be told!” Beside him, [[Broadcast|broadcast]] switched on all one hundred of her speakers, and the message travelled to every street, every river and every hidden corner of English World.
blocks.zh: 隔天中午，聲音之塔頂端響起小號聲。「請注意！」Announce 大喊，「五分鐘後，在大鐘前，真相將被說出來！」他身旁的 Broadcast 打開全部一百個喇叭，訊息傳到了英語世界的每條街、每條河和每個隱密的角落。

blocks.en: The [[audience]] that gathered in Truth Square was the largest anyone could remember. Ears of every shape and size crowded together — words from the A family, the B family, even a few shy members of the S family who had come out of hiding just for today.
blocks.zh: 聚集在真相廣場的聽眾，是大家記憶中最多的一次。各種形狀、各種大小的耳朵擠在一起——有 A 家族的字、B 家族的字，甚至還有幾個 S 家族的害羞成員，為了今天特地現身。

blocks.en: Exactly as the clock struck twelve, [[Reliable|reliable]] arrived with her lantern and took her place beside the bell. Nobody was surprised. That was the whole point of her.
blocks.zh: 鐘剛好敲第十二下時，Reliable 提著燈籠來了，站到大鐘旁邊她的位置。沒有人感到意外——她存在的意義本來就是這樣。

blocks.en: In front of the bell stood the guard with the big stamp. “Only someone with the bell’s [[permission]] may speak to it,” said [[Permission|permission]]. Sorry stepped forward, trembling. Permission studied him for a long moment, then pressed the stamp gently onto his small hand. [[Volunteer|volunteer]]’s hand shot into the air at once. “I’ll stand next to him!” she said, and she did.
blocks.zh: 大鐘前站著那位拿大印章的守衛。「只有獲得大鐘許可的人，才能對它說話。」Permission 說。Sorry 發著抖走上前。Permission 打量了他很久，然後把印章輕輕蓋在他的小手上。Volunteer 的手立刻舉到半空中：「我站在他旁邊！」她說到做到。

blocks.en: But just as Sorry opened his mouth, a familiar voice floated over from the café. “Have you heard?” said [[Gossip|gossip]], stirring her tea. “They say Sorry is only pretending. They say he’s protecting Hesitate.” “Protecting the entire S family!” added [[Exaggerate|exaggerate]], lifting his magnifying glass. “Protecting every thief in the universe!”
blocks.zh: 就在 Sorry 張開嘴的時候，咖啡館那邊飄來一個熟悉的聲音。「你聽說了嗎？」Gossip 攪著她的茶說，「聽說 Sorry 只是在演戲，聽說他是在保護 Hesitate。」「保護整個 S 家族！」Exaggerate 舉起放大鏡補充道，「保護全宇宙的小偷！」

blocks.en: Under the café table, something grey stirred. [[Rumor|rumor]] had shrunk to the size of a cat overnight, but he was hungry, and the new story smelled delicious. He began to grow.
blocks.zh: 咖啡館桌子底下，有個灰灰的東西動了一下。Rumor 一夜之間縮回了貓的大小，但他很餓，而這個新故事聞起來好香。他又開始長大了。

blocks.en: Then a figure in a long grey coat walked into the centre of the square. Where his face should have been, there was still only a smooth white surface. But this time, [[Anonymous|anonymous]] held up a sign for everyone to read: I WROTE THE NOTE. I SAW HESITATE AT THE GATE — THAT IS ALL I SAW. I SHOULD HAVE SAID SO. It was the first time in a thousand years that he had told anyone what he had done.
blocks.zh: 接著，一個穿灰色長大衣的身影走到廣場中央。他原本該有臉的地方，依然只是一片光滑的白。但這一次，Anonymous 舉起一塊牌子讓大家看：紙條是我寫的。我在城門口看到 Hesitate——我看到的就只有這樣。我早該說清楚的。這是一千年來，他第一次告訴別人自己做了什麼。

blocks.en: Rumor stopped growing. In the crowd, [[Suspect|suspect]] quietly took off both of his badges — the copper one and the silver one — and put them in his pocket.
blocks.zh: Rumor 不再長大了。人群中，Suspect 悄悄拿下了他的兩枚徽章——紅銅色的和銀色的——放進口袋。

blocks.en: [[Investigate|investigate]] stepped forward with her notebook and read out only what she knew. [[Observe|observe]] pointed at the small, wet footprints. [[Witness|witness]] described the small figure she had seen at dawn, carrying a jar — and she did not add a single detail she had not seen. Then the [[Coincidence|coincidence]] twins explained, one sentence each, how two things that happened at the same moment had been mistaken for one story.
blocks.zh: Investigate 拿著筆記本走上前，只唸出她確定的事。Observe 指著那些又小又濕的腳印。Witness 描述她在黎明時看到的、抱著罐子的小身影——她沒有多加任何一個沒親眼看到的細節。接著 Coincidence 雙胞胎一人一句，解釋兩件同時發生的事，是怎麼被誤認成同一個故事的。

blocks.en: Finally [[Evidence|evidence]] opened two pockets in his long coat. In one was the wet footprint, in the other the blue feather. Everyone looked at Sorry’s wet shoes and the blue feather in his cap. Nobody needed to say anything more.
blocks.zh: 最後，Evidence 打開長大衣上的兩個口袋，一個裝著濕腳印，一個裝著藍羽毛。大家看看 Sorry 濕濕的鞋子，再看看他帽子上的藍羽毛。沒有人需要再多說什麼。

blocks.en: At the edge of the crowd, [[Assume|assume]] was still offering his tinted glasses. A few people tried them on. Bao shook his head politely. “No, thank you,” he said. “I’ve already seen enough pictures painted by my own mind.” Nearby, [[Mislead|mislead]] pointed confidently towards the café and announced that the real story was over there. But nobody followed him today. They were all watching Observe, who was watching the bell.
blocks.zh: 人群邊緣，Assume 還在推銷他的有色眼鏡，有幾個人試戴了。小寶禮貌地搖搖頭。「不用了，謝謝，」他說，「我已經看夠自己的心畫出來的畫了。」旁邊的 Mislead 很有把握地指向咖啡館，宣稱真正的故事在那邊。但今天沒有人跟他走。大家都在看 Observe，而 Observe 正看著大鐘。

blocks.en: Sorry stood in front of the bell. He opened his mouth, and nothing came out. He tried again. Nothing. His little shoulders began to shake, and somewhere in the crowd, [[Panic|panic]] woke up and started to stretch his legs.
blocks.zh: Sorry 站在大鐘前，張開嘴，卻發不出聲音。他再試一次，還是沒有。他小小的肩膀開始發抖，人群中某處，Panic 醒了過來，開始伸展雙腿。

blocks.en: Then someone walked up and knelt beside him. It was [[Hesitate|hesitate]]. “I know how hard the first word is,” he said softly. “I am the expert. Take your time. We’ll wait.” And for once, the whole square waited with him.
blocks.zh: 這時有人走上前，在他身邊蹲下。是 Hesitate。「我知道第一個字有多難說出口，」他輕聲說，「這方面我是專家。慢慢來，我們會等你。」這一次，整個廣場都跟著他一起等。

blocks.en: Sorry took a deep breath. Beside him, [[Confess|confess]] lifted her sack of stones, ready. “I cracked you,” Sorry said to the bell. “I hid your voice because I was scared. I’m sorry.” Confess took out the last stone, and the sack was empty.
blocks.zh: Sorry 深吸一口氣。他身旁的 Confess 舉起裝石頭的袋子，準備好了。「我把你撞裂了，」Sorry 對著大鐘說，「我因為害怕，把你的聲音藏了起來。對不起。」Confess 拿出最後一顆石頭，袋子空了。

blocks.en: [[Reveal|reveal]] stepped forward with her red curtain and drew it back from the glass jar. The tiny golden sound woke, stretched, and flew straight into the bell.
blocks.zh: Reveal 拿著她的紅布簾走上前，把簾子從玻璃罐上拉開。那個小小的金色聲響醒了過來，伸了個懶腰，直直飛進大鐘裡。

blocks.en: The bell rang. It was not quite the sound everyone remembered. Overnight, [[Cooperate|cooperate]] had filled the crack with gold, and now the bell rang with a strange new shimmer inside it — a little lower, a little warmer. Many people said, later, that it was the most beautiful sound they had ever heard.
blocks.zh: 鐘響了。那不完全是大家記憶中的聲音。Cooperate 連夜用金子填補了裂縫，現在鐘聲裡多了一種奇特的新光澤——低一點，暖一點。後來很多人都說，那是他們聽過最美的聲音。

blocks.en: Above Hesitate’s head, the cracked glass crown began to glow again. Thin lines of gold now ran through it, exactly where the cracks had been. [[Reputation|reputation]] touched it gently. “It will never be quite as it was,” she said. “But I think, perhaps, it is stronger.”
blocks.zh: Hesitate 頭上那頂裂開的玻璃王冠又開始發光，原本裂開的地方，現在流淌著細細的金線。Reputation 輕輕碰了碰它。「它永遠不會完全回到原來的樣子，」她說，「但我想，它也許更堅固了。」

blocks.en: [[Accuse|accuse]], his finger now perfectly normal, shook Hesitate’s hand. [[Apologize|apologize]] bowed so deeply that his thin hat fell off. [[Genuine|genuine]] smiled his plain, real smile, and [[Sincere|sincere]] hugged Sorry so hard that his feather bent. [[Frank|frank]] said only, “Well done,” which, for Frank, was a very long speech.
blocks.zh: 手指已經完全恢復正常的 Accuse 跟 Hesitate 握了手。Apologize 深深一鞠躬，鞠到磨薄的帽子都掉了。Genuine 露出他樸實而真誠的微笑，Sincere 緊緊抱住 Sorry，抱到他的羽毛都彎了。Frank 只說了一句「做得好」——對 Frank 來說，這已經是一篇很長的演講了。

prompt.en: Bao remembers the giant story he nearly believed, and the grey glasses. Should he say it out loud?
prompt.zh: 小寶想起他差點相信的巨人故事，還有那副灰色眼鏡。他要說出來嗎？

label.en: Admit it in front of everyone

options.en: Bao walked up to the bell. “I believed the rumor too,” he said. “For a whole day, I thought Hesitate was guilty. I’m sorry.” The bell rang again — just for him — and his face turned red, and he felt lighter than he had all week.
options.zh: 小寶走到大鐘前。「我也相信過那個謠言，」他說，「整整一天，我都以為 Hesitate 有罪。對不起。」大鐘又響了一次——只為他響——他的臉紅了，卻覺得比這整個星期都輕鬆。

options.en: Bao said nothing. The bell stayed silent for him, and the feeling in his chest stayed heavy. That night he came back alone, when the square was empty, and whispered the truth to the bell. It rang softly, just once, just for him.
options.zh: 小寶什麼都沒說。大鐘沒有為他響，他胸口的感覺也一直沉甸甸的。那天晚上，他趁廣場沒人的時候獨自回來，對著大鐘小聲說出了實話。鐘輕輕響了一下，只響一次，只為他響。

after.en: Either way, the bell had taught him something no dictionary could.
after.zh: 不管哪一種，大鐘都教會了他一件字典教不了的事。

blocks.en: As the crowd began to drift home, [[Mysterious|mysterious]] appeared beside the bell in a cloud of grey fog. “So,” he said. “Did you find what you were looking for?” “Yes,” said Bao. And then, because he had learned a thing or two that week: “Did you?” Mysterious laughed — a real laugh — and disappeared.
blocks.zh: 群眾陸續散去時，Mysterious 在一團灰霧中出現在大鐘旁。「所以，」他說，「你找到你要找的東西了嗎？」「找到了。」小寶說。接著，因為這個星期他也學到了一兩招，他反問：「那你呢？」Mysterious 笑了——是真的笑——然後消失了。

blocks.en: Bao looked down at his sensor. It was glowing in every direction at once. “Little Mushroom,” he said, “I think I can see them now. Not with my eyes. I just… know where to look.” Little Mushroom grinned. “That’s what making friends with words feels like.”
blocks.zh: 小寶低頭看著感應器，它同時朝四面八方發亮。「小蘑菇，」他說，「我覺得我現在看得到他們了。不是用眼睛，而是……我知道該往哪裡看了。」小蘑菇咧嘴一笑：「跟字交朋友，就是這種感覺。」

blocks.en: Master Mu looked up at the bell, which was still humming softly in the afternoon light. “The truth does not need to be loud,” he said. “It only needs to be said.”
blocks.zh: 木大人抬頭看著大鐘，它在午後的陽光裡還輕輕嗡鳴著。「真相不需要很大聲，」他說，「它只需要被說出來。」

blocks.en: That evening, a letter arrived for Bao. It was sealed with a silver S, and it was signed by someone called Search. The Elder of the S Family, it said, would like to meet you.
blocks.zh: 那天傍晚，小寶收到一封信。信用銀色的 S 封緘，署名是一位叫 Search 的人。信上寫著：S 家族的長老，想見你一面。

insight.en: The truth does not need to be loud. It only needs to be said.
insight.zh: 真相不需要很大聲，它只需要被說出來。

quote.en: If you tell the truth you don’t have to remember anything.
quote.zh: 如果你說的是實話，就什麼都不用記。
quote.author: Mark Twain
quote.source: Mark Twain’s Notebook, ed. Albert Bigelow Paine (1935)

quiz.q: There’s a ______ going around that the test is cancelled. Don’t believe it until the teacher says so.
quiz.explain: rumor 謠言：a rumor going around 一個流傳中的謠言。

quiz.q: You can’t leave the classroom without the teacher’s ______.
quiz.explain: permission 許可：without permission、ask for permission。

quiz.q: I ______ that the shop was open, but it was closed on Sundays.
quiz.explain: assume 以為、沒查證就認定：I assumed that...。

quiz.q: He ______ to his friend for being late.
It was a ______ that we were both wearing the same shirt.
quiz.explain: coincidence 巧合：It was a coincidence that...。

quiz.q: The detective found new ______ that proved the man was innocent.
quiz.explain: evidence 證據，不可數：new evidence、a piece of evidence。
